function.arguments: {"finding_id": 1, "resolution": "The raw difference in conversion rates was biased due to confounding by customer_segment. The email channel had a higher proportion of high-converting segments (loyal, new), while paid_search had more returning customers (lower conversion). We corrected this by computing a weighted average conversion rate for each channel, using the segment-level conversion rates and the actual segment distribution within each channel. The adjusted difference (email - paid_search) is now a valid estimate of the campaign effect."}
function.name: resolve_finding
